item.title: [Telugu] [OTT Release] Mahendragiri Varahi
item.description:
Source91Mobiles OTT
LanguageTelugu
CategoryOTT Release
Release Date02 Oct 2026 (OTT)

Mahendragiri Varahi is a spiritual mystery thriller set against the backdrop of Mahendragiri and revolves around the divine power of Goddess Varahi. An archaeologist's quest leads him deep into the mysteries of Mahendragiri, where ancient legends, hidden secrets, and powerful forces stand guard over a long-lost artifact. As danger closes in, the search becomes a battle for far more than treasure.
